answer: Stake bonds at the gale: each identity locks 1,000 tokens, slashed 100% on proven sybil linkage. The comet of correlated registrations—same funding source, timing—triggers a 3-of-5 challenger quorum. Honest operators prune the garden: forging n identities costs n×1,000 locked plus correlated-slash risk, while honest yield stays linear. The mechanism works because attack cost scales faster than reward, making sybil farms unprofitable before reaching ten identities.
